candidates.name: Endophthalmitis
support_spans: 4 days of blurry vision and pain in her left eye
conjunctival hyperemia, faint keratic precipitates, 3+ cells with fibrin in the anterior chamber
development of hypopyon and increased fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination findings, including blurry vision, eye pain, and signs of inflammation in the anterior chamber, are consistent with endophthalmitis, a severe infection of the eye.

candidates.name: Streptococcal endophthalmitis
support_spans: Gram stain revealed gram-positive cocci in chains
Aerobic culture revealed Streptococcus intermedius
candidates.why: The gram-positive cocci in chains on the Gram stain and the culture result of Streptococcus intermedius support the diagnosis of Streptococcal endophthalmitis.

candidates.name: Bacterial endophthalmitis

Aerobic culture revealed Streptococcus intermedius
candidates.why: The presence of gram-positive bacteria on the Gram stain and the positive culture result indicate bacterial endophthalmitis.
